title: Razor-sharp stone cuts at Kef Kalesi

tellings.quote: examples from ke excuse me from KF kesi that have um cuts that are so sharp you can still cut your finger on them

plain: At Kef Kalesi, an ancient site in Turkey, there are said to be cuts in the stone so sharp that you can still cut your finger on them. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this as one example among others, without naming a source. If true, it would point to stonework done with more skill than people usually credit to the distant past.
